facts.textJa: 系譜・一覧の別記録では「There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had twenty-four fingers and toes, six on each hand and six on each foot; and he also was born to the giant.」と記されます。
系譜・一覧の別記録では「These were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.」と記されます。

wikipedia.locator: § Battles against the Philistines, “Verse 8”, lines 178–184, especially 182–183: reproduces the verse’s “giant in Gath” wording and discusses the Hebrew forms Rapha/Raphah.
